dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-thorax, transitioning into a sharp inward taper at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth with continuous convex curvature; no localized asymmetrical structural bulges or indentations are visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity with uniform reflectance across the dorsal plane, filtered for minor specular highlights.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single high-contrast dark circular feature is visible at the anterior (blowhole); no distinct point-contrast lesions or rake marks are observed.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent transverse (horizontal) indentation is visible across the posterior dorsal region, causing a distinct geometric disruption and shadow-casting crease.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant horizontal skin fold or healed linear compression mark spans the width of the lower dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark, narrow longitudinal ridge or pigment line is visible extending from the posterior indentation toward the caudal extremity.
